derivedAudits.evidence: src/app/schedule.ts stageStatus compares only today against start/end. src/app/components/RoundTable.tsx renders “Open now” whenever that result is now. Therefore after registration’s noon cutoff (12:00 = 720), payment’s 3:00 PM cutoff (900), or choice cutoff (10:00 = 600), the UI still shows “Open now” until midnight. The existing test only checks day-level states, including registration on 21 October as now; it does not test after-cutoff time-of-day behavior.

derivedAudits.evidence: ProfilePage course choices map clinical to “MD / MS / Diploma / DNB” and dental to “MDS”; src/engine/profile.ts defines specialities as a separate string array. The course enum is a broad profile category used by the schedule mismatch warning, not a list of clinical specialties.

keyFindings: All 188 visible fields have an individual fieldId/path entry and one or more claim-level outcomes.
The schedule marks dates tentative; “dates may change” is a normal paraphrase of that notice.
The internal “clinical” course enum maps to MD / MS / Diploma / DNB; the separate MDS warning is supported by the PDF’s NEET-PG scope and absence of an MDS mention.
The schedule states “Server Time” but does not specify the timezone; code assumes Asia/Kolkata.
Stage status remains “Open now” after a printed cutoff on the end date.
The collapsed college/MCC summary omits the Round 2 seat-matrix 1:00 PM cutoff.
meta.title is not rendered on the current schedule/home pages; the visible heading uses shortTitle.
The official MCC link was verified on https://mcc.nic.in/; the URL is not printed in the schedule.
summary.testContext: Read-only inspection of existing src/app/schedule.test.ts and src/app/deadline.test.ts; no tests were run. Existing tests cover representative next-date ordering and countdown arithmetic, but do not cover time-aware stageStatus after same-day closing cutoffs or time visibility in the collapsed college/MCC summary.
